## Packages

```{r}
library(readxl)
library(readr)
library(arrow)
library(dplyr)
```

## ARCEP fibre

```{r}
fibre <- read_excel("data/2026t2-obs-hd-thd-deploiement-vf.xlsx",
                    sheet = "Communes", skip = 4, col_types = "text")
write_csv(fibre, "data/arcep_fibre_communes.csv")
dim(fibre)
```

## COG

```{r}
cog <- read_excel("data/table_passage_annuelle_2026.xlsx",
                  skip = 5, col_types = "text")
write_csv(cog, "data/cog_table_passage_2026.csv")
head(cog)
```

## Census 2017

```{r}
rp <- read_delim("data/base-cc-emploi-pop-active-2017.CSV",
                 delim = ";", col_types = cols(.default = "c"))
rp2017 <- rp |>
  select(CODGEO, starts_with("C17_ACTOCC1564"))
write_csv(rp2017, "data/rp2017_emploi_commune.csv")
head(rp2017)
```

## SIRENE

```{r}
sirene <- open_dataset("data/stock-stocketablissement-parquet.parquet") |>
  select(codeCommuneEtablissement, dateCreationEtablissement) |>
  collect() |>
  mutate(year = as.integer(substr(as.character(dateCreationEtablissement), 1, 4))) |>
  filter(year >= 2014, !is.na(codeCommuneEtablissement)) |>
  count(codeCommuneEtablissement, year, name = "n_creations")
write_csv(sirene, "data/sirene_creations_by_municipality_year.csv")
head(sirene)
```
